name: Cartoon Cloud Density Generation
definition: A procedural method for generating cartoon-style cloud densities using independent noise sets for macro structure, body puffs, edge details, and flow, combined with geometric envelopes for specific cloud types.
summary: Cartoon Cloud Density Generation is a procedural method creating stylized cloud densities using multi-octave noise and geometric envelopes, differing from blocky clouds by relying on noise functions rather than static 2D maps.
